newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Explosion at northern Taiwan refinery, one dead.
newsitem.headline: Explosion at northern Taiwan refinery, one dead.

text.p: A small explosion at state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp's northern Taiwan refinery on Monday killed one person and damaged a pump control room, officials said from the facility at Taoyuan.
An official reached by telephone said the accident was not expected to slow the refinery's production as a backup control system was being put into use immediately.
The affected pump room controls the desulfurisation unit for jet fuel production, he said.
The gas explosion blasted away the control room's door, which in turn hit and seriously injured worker, the official said. The worker died at the scene.
The official declined to give further details, saying an announcement would be issued later on Monday.
The Taoyuan refinery mainly makes jet fuel, turning out 60,000 tonnes a month at full capacity. It is the principal supplier to Taipei's busy international airport at Taoyuan.
